items.title: Dedupe full-identity-triple re-attestations in evaluateHostVerdictRounds before fraud-detection grouping
items.context: core/host-independence.ts evaluateHostVerdictRounds: before grouping a run's accepted verdicts through groupByIndependentHost, collapse verdicts sharing the exact (hostId, sessionId, keyId) triple into one (keep the latest by ledger/array order -- append-only, chronological), so a benign same-host re-attestation supersedes rather than poisons. Partial identity overlaps (different hostId sharing only session or key) must remain untouched and still flow into the existing union-find fraud check.
items.userSees: A story whose host_verdict ledger contains a benign re-attestation (same host, same identity, re-submitted after a storyFilesHash-stable material drift) now has that round counted as valid instead of invalidated as 'duplicate host/session/key identity'. A story whose ledger contains two DIFFERENT hostIds sharing one session/key (impersonation) is still correctly rejected.
